chunks: A lamb and a young goat suckle from the milk of a sow or a woman.
And Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: “Do not eat from the meat of a lamb that suckled from a sow.”

key_terms.خِنْزِيرَةٍ: a sow; the source of prohibited suckling here

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat the meat of a lamb that suckled from a sow?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal prohibition regarding eating the meat of a lamb that has suckled from a sow. It reflects rulings related to halal and haram food and the effects of impure or prohibited nourishment on an animal.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: A LAMB OR A YOUNG GOAT THAT SUCKLES FROM THE MILK OF A SOW OR A WOMAN.

Hadith.4194 - And Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"Do not eat the meat of a lamb that has suckled from a sow."
